How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NBT Media Coordinator Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nbtindia.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBT Media Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the NBT Media Coordinator position is 28th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Media Coordinator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Media Studies, or a related field from a recognized university. A Master's degree in the relevant field is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Media Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Media Coordinator post is 45 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Media Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Media Coordinator position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 80,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Media Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Media Coordinator post in the National Book Trust India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NBT Media Coordinator recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Media Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Media Coordinator position will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the NBT Media Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NBT Media Coordinator recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Media Coordinator position is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the NBT located?
faq.answer: The National Book Trust India (NBT) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110070.
